**Daily Devotional**

**May 12**

*12 But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name: (John 1:12 KJV)*

Even though Jesus was rejected by many of the Jews, those that did believe in Him were given the power to become sons of God. This doesn’t just mean when we get to Heaven, but Jesus gave us this power just as soon as we believe in Him. This is all the power of the Godhead, and our born again experience gives us the very Spirit of Jesus Himself (Galatians 4:6), so that we might have all the benefits, not just in Heaven, but right now here on earth (John 10:10).

Stop and think on these things. What an awesome thing that we have the very Spirit and power of Jesus living on the inside of us. This includes forgiveness of our sins and eternal life (John 3:16), the power to be healed (1 Peter 2:24, Matthew 8:17, Psalms 103:3), prosperity (3 John 1:2) as well as power over Satan (James 4:7). It is beyond me why most preachers only teach the forgiveness of our sins, as we sure need the rest of Christ’s power in this life, before we can live in the abundance of what God has given us. Help us Lord, to understand what we already have (Philemon 1:6). Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
